opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers, supporting recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, as well as future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London who face additional barriers based on their location, with financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Tees Valley, as well as future industry professionals based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London who face additional barriers based on their location, with financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music

deadlines.raw: TBC (one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who are writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career. One bumper deadline planned for the second half of 2026.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing events. Rolling deadlines (SXSW 2026 deadline has closed).

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK, with potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for composers with a strong track record giving direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career, supporting up to 15 composers per year.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000 and £10,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career independent promoters across England.
opportunities.summary: Recognises the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, offering grant funding and capacity building support of up to £3,500 for booking, programming and promotion of gigs, capacity building and related costs.
